item.title: Patch now: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches: Stack-Based Buffer Overflow
item.description:
Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches: Memory corruption (possible RCE) · pre-auth · adjacent network · exploited · fix: 2.90(aahh.2)c0, 2.90(aahi.2)c0, 2.90(aazi.2)c0

First step: Update Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches to the fixed version for your release line (for example 2.90(aahh.2)c0, 2.90(aahi.2)c0 or 2.90(aazi.2)c0).

Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-7273, CVE-2026-107441
